messages.author: d2ea9667a5ee856d
messages.subject: One inflated modelling using glmmTMB
parts:
Hi all,

Does anyone know if there is a way to modelling one-inflated data using glmmTMB or any other TMB function? I am aware about the zero inflation modelling using such functions, but the case I am working on is with one-inflation.
Thank you very much.

Best regards, 
Allison

messages.author: fd4f3538f907404b
messages.subject: Re: [TMB users] One inflated modelling using glmmTMB
parts:
Hi Allison,

Can you post this as an issue on the glmmTMB issues list
<https://github.com/glmmTMB/glmmTMB/issues> ? (This Cross-Validated
post suggests that VGAM::vglm() can handle one-inflated Poisson models ...)

https://stats.stackexchange.com/questions/90817/why-are-there-no-one-inflated-count-data-models

It *might* be possible to hack/hijack the ziformula machinery to
handle one-inflation (not with the package as it exists, but maybe
without adding too much additional code to the model ...)

cheers
Ben Bolker
